segments.an3.43:1.1: “Tayo, bhikkhave, atthavase sampassamānena alameva paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
segments.an3.43:1.3: Yo dhammaṃ deseti so atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca.
segments.an3.43:1.4: Yo dhammaṃ suṇāti so atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca.
segments.an3.43:1.5: Yo ceva dhammaṃ deseti yo ca dhammaṃ suṇāti ubho atthappaṭisaṃvedino ca honti dhammappaṭisaṃvedino ca.
segments.an3.43:1.6: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo atthavase sampassamānena alameva paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetun”ti.

lines: Tatiye tayo, bhikkhave, atthavase sampassamānenāti tayo atthe tīṇi kāraṇāni passantena.
Yo dhammaṃ desetīti yo puggalo catusaccadhammaṃ pakāseti.
Tatiye attho nāma phalaṃ, taṃ etassa vasoti atthavaso.
Hetu, attho etassa atthīti attho, so evāti āha “tayo atthe tīṇi kāraṇānī”ti.
Dhammadesanā nāma ukkaṭṭhaniddesena catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ pakāsanāti āha “catusaccadhammaṃ pakāsetī”ti.
Aṭṭhakathaṃ ñāṇena paṭisaṃvedīti pāḷipadānaṃ atthaṃ vivaraṇañāṇena paṭi paṭi saṃvedanasīlo “ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho”ti.
Pāḷidhammaṃ paṭisaṃvedīti pāḷigatiṃ pāḷiṃ padavivaraṇaṃ paṭi paṭi saṃvedanasīlo.
